thread:
maria: Hey team — noticed a bunch of tenant cost deltas today that seem correlated with fallback routing. hypothesis: we lose 'cost_lineage' somewhere between edge and the enrich service. anyone seen this pattern? :confused:
aj: saw similar in logs earlier, looks like when route falls back to the cheap model variant we drop some tags. not 100% sure where.
ravi: is this the header we added in the sdk last month? `x-cost-lineage`?
maria: yes — idea was to carry which policy/router made the decision plus final model variant. cheap and useful for console breakouts.
sara: quick note: adding headers at edge is low-latency but increases packet size. we need to quantify p50/p95 impact and any sampling mismatch.
aj: can we instead emit the lineage at ingest enrich step? enrich already does tenant normalization. downside: we lose routing attribution for short-lived proxies that never hit enrich (e.g., early rejects).
maria: true. plus some billing consumers join earlier in pipeline for near-real-time invoices. they currently read route tags off the proxy event.
ravi: proposal: keep `x-cost-lineage` at edge, but also write a compact lineage fingerprint into the event: `lineage_fp = sha1(policy_id + variant)` — cheap and small. billing can resolve fingerprint -> full lineage from a batch join.
sara: okay but that implies a join table and backfill story. console dashboards will need to show the readable lineage immediately for preview mode. we could resolve async and show "resolved later" on rows.
aj: concern: if fingerprint collisions happen we could misattribute cents. collision risk with sha1 truncated to 8 chars is tiny but not zero. maybe use 16 chars.
maria: agree on 16. also need to ensure we redact any PII from policy names before hashing.
ops-bot: deploy queued: ingest-enrich v2 -> staging at 2026-04-12T10:12:00Z by ci/CD.
ravi: meta question — do we change the edge proxy contract? breaking internal SDKs sucks. can we make this additive (accept new header but default unchanged)?
sara: yes additive. edge will log but not require header. fallback routers will attach lineage when present.
aj: rollout plan: 1) edge logs lineage_fp in shadow mode (no consumer reads) for 48h 2) enable billing consumer join using fp-resolver in preview 3) if stable, switch consumer primary to fp and remove old tag field.
maria: add dashboard panels: unmatched_fingerprints, resolver_latency, and percentage_resolved within 5m. also track cost delta per resolver failure.
ravi: who owns the resolver table? probably metering team. cc @maria for requirements.
sara: storage considerations: table growth estimate: ~10M distinct fingerprints/day per region if every route is unique. we should TTL at 30d and compress.
aj: also need migration for historical invoices if we want consistent analytics. probably only do partial backfill for last 7 days.
maria: action items: aj + ravi to run a perf test with 16-char fp appended at edge (payload size & p95), sara to draft dashboard widgets and TTL policy, I'll write spec for fp->lineage resolver API and privacy redaction rules.
aj: putting a PR up for edge shadowing today. will paste link when ready.
ravi: once PR is up, ops-bot can canary deploy to eu-west for 2h and we monitor console panels.
maria: thanks — small wins but should stop these surprise cost shifts. :thumbsup:
